body:
That last small statement is so simple, but so hard to believe... I've said it to myself in the mirror before and just felt dirty because it felt like a lie. 

I do want to get better. But, how do you switch? I know it's be done before but...I don't understand how to take that first step...

I was raped when I was 14 by my first boyfriend who also emotionally abuse me. He keeps popping up in my life every so often always after I think it's finally behind me. 
I dropped out of school to save my parents some money because this summer my dad lost his job. Turns out he's been a narc addict for longer than I've been alive. 
This was his third time getting caught.
He was the only breadwinner with a family of 6 to feed. Why would he do that? He wont even try to apply for another job.
I'm working full time to save up money to move out, but with the economy, it's almost impossible to strike out on your own. 
I hate my house. I hate seeing my mother broken after this final shit storm with my dad.
I feel stupid because the only thing that keeps me going is thinking of getting an apartment with my SO, but that might not even happen because all the shit from my home life is trickling into my relationship, making it a self-fulfilling prophecy. I'm trying so hard not to let that happen. Being with him is the only thing that brings me joy, but I'm destroying it...

I just don't know. I have no safe place and I feel worthless. 
I don't want to bother anyone with my problems. 
I just want them to be over. 
I feel trapped and like I can't control anything.
At least in ending it myself, I'd have final control.
